description: E5 / paper Section IV and App. C: the universality proof's construction (uniform |Gamma>, observable built from target coefficients) with the Pauli-rotation family H_m = (1/2) sum_i Z_i. Part 1: random truncated series of degree K reproduced exactly with m = K and m = K + 2. Part 2: sign(sin x) approximated with m = K = 1..10; RMS error compared with the exact Parseval truncation error.
